photos.title: First photo from the lunar surface (Luna 9)
photos.caption: The first photograph from the lunar surface, taken by Luna 9 in Oceanus Procellarum on 3 February 1966.
photos.credit: National Space Science Data Center / Luna 9 (USSR), published by NASA
photos.license: Public domain (published by NASA; original Luna 9 automatic-camera image)

photos.title: Surveyor 1 on Oceanus Procellarum
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of Surveyor 1 on Oceanus Procellarum, the first U.S. spacecraft to soft-land on the Moon (2 June 1966).
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: Estimated Luna 13 landing area in Oceanus Procellarum
photos.caption: LROC WAC mosaic of the estimated Luna 13 landing area in Oceanus Procellarum. The lander itself is not visible, and the coordinates are a historical estimate, not LROC-confirmed.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: Alan Bean with Surveyor 3 at the Apollo 12 site
photos.caption: Apollo 12 astronaut Alan Bean stands with Surveyor 3; the Apollo 12 Lunar Module Intrepid is on the horizon.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA media)

photos.title: Surveyor 5 in a small crater
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of Surveyor 5 sitting in a 10-meter-diameter crater (M106726943LE).
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: Surveyor 6 on the plains of Sinus Medii
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of Surveyor 6 on Sinus Medii, casting an 18-meter shadow with the Sun 8° above the horizon.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: Surveyor 7 on the ejecta of Tycho
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of Surveyor 7 on the ejecta blanket of Tycho crater, the only Surveyor to land in the lunar highlands.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: Buzz Aldrin at Tranquility Base
photos.caption: Buzz Aldrin walks on the lunar surface near a landing-leg of the Lunar Module Eagle at Tranquility Base.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA media)

photos.title: Apollo 12 astronaut beside the flag
photos.caption: An Apollo 12 astronaut stands beside the U.S. flag after it was unfurled at the Oceanus Procellarum landing site.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA media)

photos.title: Luna 16 descent stage
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of the Luna 16 descent stage, the first successful robotic lunar sample-return spacecraft.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: Luna 17 landing site and rover tracks
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of the Luna 17 site on Mare Imbrium, with the spacecraft, rover tracks, and an enlargement of the vehicle (M175502049RE).
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: Apollo 14 Lunar Module on the Moon
photos.caption: The Apollo 14 Lunar Module Antares on the Moon at the Fra Mauro landing site.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA media)

photos.title: James Irwin at the Lunar Roving Vehicle
photos.caption: James Irwin works at the Lunar Roving Vehicle during an Apollo 15 EVA at Hadley-Apennine, with the LM Falcon behind him.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA media)

photos.title: Luna 20 descent stage in the highlands
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of the Luna 20 descent stage in the rugged highlands between Mare Fecunditatis and Mare Crisium.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA/LROC); credit requested as NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University

photos.title: John Young salutes the flag at Descartes
photos.caption: John Young leaps from the surface to salute the flag at the Descartes landing site, with the rover and LM Orion nearby.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA media)

photos.title: Harrison Schmitt beside the flag at Taurus-Littrow
photos.caption: Harrison Schmitt stands beside the deployed U.S. flag on the floor of the Taurus-Littrow valley.
photos.license: Public domain (NASA media)

photos.title: Luna 21 lander and Lunokhod 2 tracks

photos.title: Luna 23 on its side in Mare Crisium
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of the entire Luna 23 vehicle on its side in Mare Crisium after a high-speed landing (M174868307R).

photos.title: Luna 24 in Mare Crisium
photos.caption: LROC NAC view of Luna 24 on the northwestern rim of a 64-meter crater in Mare Crisium, with an enlargement of the lander.

photos.title: Chang'e 3 lander and Yutu rover from above

photos.title: Chang'e 4 rover comes into view

photos.title: First look: Chang'e 5
